note: 16 Nov: the same 45 jobs as jobs-trial2, now each in its own test world (the owner: "it was supposed to have files for every job it could do and ask for"). Flash-Next first writes each job's scene (the files, folders, board lists and memory the request takes for granted; saved to scenes.jsonl), folders outside the home are mirrored, the Hands that would act on the real PC are off, and web search goes through Bob's own web_search with the Lab's Tavily key behind it (the owner: "Use Tavily ... for making lessons"). Pre-flight checks the key with one search and stops if web search answers nothing. Every run is kept in full for Opus 5.5 to read and compare with run 2. H200, 2 jobs at a time. Caps 1 h / $5.
